perusahaan.title: About Digitak
perusahaan.aboutText1: PT Metanouva Informatika, or Digitak, is an Information Technology company established since 1999. PT Metanouva Informatika (Digitak) has extensive experience collaborating with many organizations in both the government and private sectors through the IT products and services we provide.
perusahaan.aboutText2: By combining deep experience, superior technical expertise, continuous innovation, and a high level of professionalism, we always deliver the best products and services for our clients' needs.
perusahaan.aboutText3: We are proud of our reputation for not only striving to meet expectations but also committing to go beyond the boundaries, helping our clients stay at the forefront of ever-increasing competition.
perusahaan.aboutText4: As a reliable and results-oriented partner, we believe that strong collaboration between us and our clients is the key to success. Together, let's build a bright and sustainable business future.
perusahaan.valuesDesc: 'ASK IT' is our core values that serve as the foundation and trust of our company, namely Andal (Reliable), Solutif (Solution), Kolaboratif (Collaborative), Inovatif (Innovative), and Tumbuh (Grow).

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: How PT Metanouva Informatika (Digitak.id) collects, uses, and protects your data when you use our website.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: PT Metanouva Informatika (Digitak.id) respects your privacy. This policy explains how we manage the personal information we obtain when you visit our website, submit a project request, or subscribe to our newsletter.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: We may collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, organization name, customer type, and project needs description through our request form. We also collect email addresses when you subscribe to our newsletter, along with basic technical data (such as IP address and device) when you visit the website.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use this information to process and manage your requests, provide request status updates, send news or service information (if you subscribe), and improve the quality of our services and website.

sections.title: Storage & Security
sections.body: Your data is stored with reasonable security measures and is only accessible to internal parties who need it to deliver our services. We never sell your personal data to any third party.

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.body: Data is only shared with third parties strictly necessary to process your request — for example infrastructure partners or email providers — and only to the extent required.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, or request the deletion of your personal data. To do so, please contact us at info@digitak.id and we will follow up in accordance with applicable regulations.

sections.title: Policy Changes
sections.body: This policy may be updated from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated through this website.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.subtitle: Terms of use and services of PT Metanouva Informatika (Digitak.id).

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing this website or submitting a request through the form, you are deemed to have read, understood, and agreed to the terms & conditions below. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

sections.title: Our Services
sections.body: Digitak provides IT consulting, software development, ERP solutions, system integration, IT infrastructure, and training & maintenance services tailored to each client's needs.

sections.title: Project Submission
sections.body: Submitting a request through the form does not immediately constitute a binding work agreement. Our team will review your needs and contact you for follow-up. Cost estimates and schedules provided are indicative until an official offer is agreed.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content, designs, logos, and materials on this website are the property of Digitak and may not be used, copied, or distributed without written permission.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Services are provided with best effort. We are not liable for indirect losses arising from the use of the website or delays beyond our reasonable control.

sections.title: Terms Changes
sections.body: These terms & conditions may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the website after changes means you accept the latest version.

sections.title: Governing Law & Contact
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. For further questions, contact us at info@digitak.id
